description: Land Title Settlement Department - Pathagama, Mirigama D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510211 (23/0892)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed information about land ownership, parcel numbers, extents, owner identities, and encumbrances. The content is focused entirely on land registration and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) which covers land registrations, property ownership, land titles, and related matters.
